chat_messages.content: How many studio albums were published by Mercedes Sosa between 2000 and 2009 (included)? You can use the latest 2022 version of english wikipedia.

I’ll verify Mercedes Sosa’s discography against the English Wikipedia entries and count only studio albums released from 2000 through 2009 inclusive.
The relevant source is public Wikipedia content rather than the agent’s stored documents, so I’m searching the web for the discography and album-release listings.
















```python
search_results = await web_search("Mercedes Sosa discography studio albums 2000 2009 English Wikipedia", max_results=5)
print(search_results)
```
